seoTitle: Sell Physical and Digital Products on Squarespace
metaDescription: List physical or digital products in your Squarespace store with pricing, images, and descriptions, then publish to start selling.
intro: Whether you're launching a new online shop or expanding an existing one, Squarespace supports listing both physical and digital products through the same core workflow. This guide covers adding a physical product from start to finish, with the digital process following nearly the same steps.

steps.heading: Log in and choose your site
steps.body: Sign in to Squarespace, using Continue with Google if linked, then select the site you want to manage from your dashboard.

steps.heading: Open Products
steps.body: Locate the Products and Services menu, then click the Products tab to manage existing items or add new ones.

steps.heading: Add a new product
steps.body: Click Add Product and choose between a physical or digital product depending on what you're selling.

steps.heading: Enter product details
steps.body: Add a clear product name, a detailed description explaining what it is and why someone would want it, and upload well-lit images from multiple angles.

steps.heading: Set the price and publish
steps.body: Price the product competitively, then use the save dropdown menu and click Publish to make it live on your site.

faq.question: Is selling a digital product different from a physical one?
faq.answer: The setup process is nearly identical — you'll choose the appropriate product type, and for digital items you'll upload a file instead of managing shipping.

faq.question: How many product images should I upload?
faq.answer: Multiple well-lit images from different angles help customers understand what they're buying and boost confidence in the purchase.

faq.question: Can I sell an unlimited quantity of a product?
faq.answer: Yes, Squarespace lets you set stock levels, including unlimited availability for digital items or made-to-order physical goods.

faq.question: What happens after I click Publish?
faq.answer: The product becomes live on your website, visible and purchasable by visitors immediately.
